headline: Resolutions on the noise ordinance, City website improvements, neighborhood ward meetings, and a City Council newsletter.
summary: Items include a resolution to update the noise ordinance and one to improve the City website. Other items cover scheduling neighborhood ward meetings and publishing a City Council newsletter.
items: Resolution to publish City Council newsletter (24-354)
Resolution to schedule neighborhood ward meetings hosted by City Council (26-024)
Resolution to update the noise ordinance (26-138)
Resolution to improve the City website (26-169)
Papers in committee, viewable by emailing ahurtubise@medford-ma.gov
location: City Council Chamber, 2nd Floor, Medford City Hall, 85 George P. Hassett Drive, Medford, MA, and via Zoom
